question: Which of the following awards was received by Pandit Birju Maharaj in 1986?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Vibhushan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Pandit Birju Maharaj:-**

 
 
• **He was a renowned Indian Kathak dancer, composer, singer, and artist. **
 
• He was a leading exponent of the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Kathak dance in India.
 
• Birju Maharaj made several important contributions to the field of Kathak dance.
 
• He refined the technique and style of the dance, and he helped to popularize Kathak dance to a wider audience.
 
• He also choreographed several dance dramas that used Kathak dance as a form of storytelling.
 
• **Birju Maharaj was honored with several awards for his work, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1964), Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan (1986). **
